summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Latvian documents: eight PMLP tables of first-time temporary residence permits 2015-2022, the PMLP 2015 annual report, a 2026 PMLP press release and ten versions of the Immigration Law. New rows are almost all from the permit tables: every non-zero investor cell by nationality (main applicants and family members, four routes), plus the EU/EEA and third-country totals and the 'other countries' row; all columns add up to their printed totals. The laws add three renewal-payment terms and three events (work rights 2014, suspension power and tax-debt annulment 2016, renewal payment for older-rule holders 2018).

program_terms.applies_to: holders of investor permits granted under earlier versions of points 28-30 (transitional points 26, 27, 31, 33), on their first renewal; payable at once or in EUR 1,000 instalments, the rest yearly at registration
program_terms.location: Transitional provisions, points 26, 27, 31 and 33 (last sentences) and point 45
program_terms.quote: 5000 euro apmērā veic vienā maksājumā atkārtotās termiņuzturēšanās atļaujas saņemšanas brīdī vai pa daļām, pirmo daļējo maksājumu 1000 euro apmērā
program_terms.notes: Amendments of 22.11.2017, in force 1 Jan 2018 (transitional point 45; applications received by 31 Dec 2017 keep the earlier wording). The 2016 text exempted these older-rule holders from the EUR 5,000 renewal payment of art. 23(7.3). valid_to is the last day of the 2002 law.

program_terms.applies_to: business investor (art. 27(1) p. 10) renewing after at least five years' residence on that ground, single payment
program_terms.quote: viņš, saņemot termiņuzturēšanās atļauju, samaksā vienā maksājumā valsts budžetā 2000 euro
program_terms.notes: Not due, and first-permit rules apply instead, when the renewal is requested more than 90 days after the earlier permit expired or the investment object changes. Paid into the budget programme 'Ekonomikas attīstības programma' (art. 30).

program_terms.applies_to: holders of permits under the old property and bank routes (old art. 23(1) points 29-30) and their family members renewing for up to five years; EUR 1,000 per year of the previous and the new permit, minus amounts already paid under old art. 23(7.3) and (8)
program_terms.location: New Immigration Law, Transitional provisions, point 10(4)
program_terms.quote: Maksājuma apmēru nosaka 1000 euro apmērā par katru iepriekšējās un saskaņā ar šo likumu piešķirtās termiņuzturēšanās atļaujas gadu
program_terms.notes: Amount is per permit year, not a one-off sum. Renewal also gives unrestricted right to work; the investment must still meet the old point 29 or 30 conditions. Transitional points 8-9 set how the EUR 5,000 old-law payment is counted for business-route holders and for those switching to another ground.

events.title: Investors and their families get unrestricted right to work
events.description: The rewritten art. 9 of the Immigration Law (amendments of 05.12.2013, in force 1 Jan 2014) lists holders of temporary residence permits under art. 23(1) points 28, 29 and 30 (company, property and bank investors) and their family members among foreigners granted the right to work without restrictions. Point 31 (state securities) holders were added from 1 Jan 2015 (art. 9(5) p. 24).
events.quote: 13) termiņuzturēšanās atļauju kā persona, kura veikusi ieguldījumu kapitālsabiedrības pamatkapitālā saskaņā ar šā likuma 23.panta pirmās daļas 28.punktu, vai kā šīs personas ģimenes loceklis

events.title: Government may suspend investor permits for named countries; tax-debt annulment
events.description: Amendments of 09.06.2016 (in force 1 Jul 2016) let the Cabinet suspend, for up to five years, the issue of investor permits (art. 23(1) points 28-31) to nationals of named third countries on national-security or economic grounds (art. 23(9)-(10), art. 34(6)), and add annulment of a permit under these points when the holder owes more than EUR 150 in taxes administered by the State Revenue Service (art. 35(1) p. 30). They also require the investee company of a business investor to pay at least EUR 40,000 (small company) or EUR 100,000 (large company) in taxes each year (art. 23(7.1)-(7.2)).
events.quote: uz noteiktu laiku, bet ne ilgāk kā uz pieciem gadiem var tikt apturēta termiņuzturēšanās atļauju saskaņā ar šā panta pirmās daļas 28., 29., 30. vai 31.punktu izsniegšana

events.title: Older-rule investors must pay EUR 5,000 on first renewal
events.description: Amendments of 22.11.2017 (in force 1 Jan 2018) end the exemption from the EUR 5,000 renewal payment for investors whose permits were granted under earlier versions of points 28-30: on their first renewal they pay EUR 5,000 at once or in EUR 1,000 yearly instalments (transitional points 26, 27, 31, 33; point 45).
events.quote: Šā likuma grozījumi par pārejas noteikumu 26. punkta pēdējā teikuma, 27. punkta pēdējā teikuma, 31. punkta pēdējā teikuma un 33. punkta pēdējā teikuma izteikšanu jaunā redakcijā stājas spēkā 2018. gada 1. janvārī
